item.title: Passing the GPEN
item.description:
This week I took and passed the GPEN exam. Here are some thoughts about how the class and exam went.

I took the SEC560 class the last week in June. I opted for the Live Online format as I have found when taking previous courses that this is a good balance of cost (my employer wouldn’t fly me somewhere to take a class in-person) and having a live instructor available for questions in real time. I don’t think I have the discipline and self-motivation needed to consume a completely self-paced class, so this was a good option. The class itself was great - this was my first time taking a class delivered by Jeff and I thought he did an awesome job. I enjoyed the tangents about real-world examples or side projects he’s working on.

item.title: GWAPT Certification Review
item.description:
In an effort to gain another cert this year, this past month I took SANS SEC542 and completed the GIAC Web Application Penetration Tester (GWAPT) certification.

For context, this class is the entry-level webapp pentesting course SANS has. I have 6 years of experience doing AppSec testing so I knew going in the material would be mostly review with hopefully a few unfamiliar topics.
